proc_p: Panelling usually takes four to six weeks to make after you approve the design.
steps: We measure the wall, mark the sockets and switches, and look at the furniture around it.
You see the panelling, slats or mouldings in 3D in your room, with a quote that lists every piece.
Every panel is cut to your wall in our workshop, with the sockets and switches allowed for.
We fit and finish the panelling so it looks part of the house, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send a photo of the wall on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure it, mark the sockets and switches, and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
